brief.headline: Silk Polypack publishes no financials, so qualify Huhtamaki or UFLEX as a second source and push payment to 15 days to free up ₹320 cash for us.

priceAsk.summary: Hold price at current level; ask for commitment to stay within the market fair band.
priceAsk.basis: The market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg, and our price sits at the top of that fair band — no room to push lower without a second quote in hand.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move payment from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt.

brief.financialLeverage: Silk Polypack does not publish financials, so we can't see their profit, debt, or how tight their cash is. Our ₹7775 annual spend is tiny — we have almost no scale leverage. That means we lean on the threat of a second source and on paying faster (15 days frees ₹320 for us) rather than a hard price squeeze. Line up Huhtamaki or UFLEX as a backup converter before you push, so the alternate is real.

evidence.point: Silk Polypack publishes no financial statements
Our annual spend with them is very small
Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate sits in a fair band
BOPET film import unit value (a substrate benchmark) is lower
Paying 15 days earlier frees up cash for us

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter, already a tiny FDC supplier, revenue ₹2755.75 Cr — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets.

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant, both film substrate and conversion, revenue ₹17547.92 Cr — can second-source at scale.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter, revenue ₹222.04 Cr — strong second-source for pharma blister/sachet laminates.

risks: We have no financial visibility into Silk Polypack (no published accounts), so we can't gauge their stability or cash pressure.
Our ₹7775 spend is tiny — we are not a big customer, so our negotiating muscle is weak.
The market asking price verdict is 'top of fair band' — pushing price lower without a competing quote may fail or sour the relationship.
None of the alternates (Huhtamaki, UFLEX, Constantia) are qualified yet — you must audit and price them before they become real leverage.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to move to 15-day payment to help both of us manage cash better, and at the same time we're qualifying a second laminate source so we have supply security — let's talk about how we keep this partnership stable.
